messages.en: If you don't mind, could you help me check this file quickly?
Don't mind at all. Just send it over. I've finished my work.
I happen to be heading to that shop. Want me to pick up a drink for you while I'm there?
Yes, just one iced milk tea, please. Thanks!
I can't come to work today. There's an emergency at home.
Okay, take care of that first. I've already let our supervisor know.
I'm really disappointed. I went for two interviews and still didn't get the job.
That must be really upsetting. I'm here if you want to talk.
